display.purpose: Title, lot name, SOLD word; sized to fill the measure (cqi clamps / FitText). Arabic: Lalezar, line-height 1.22, no tracking.

bid-figure.purpose: Current bid in the holder ink; tabular lining figures.

headline.purpose: Section heads, resume and act titles.

title.purpose: Topbar title, corner names, button text.

slab.purpose: Ratings, OVR column, values. Arabic: Rakkas, line-height 1.35.

body.purpose: Rules text, notes, hints in both scripts.

label.purpose: Corner tags, stat heads, bid labels; uppercase, 0.08em tracking.

label-ar.purpose: Label role under :lang(ar): Changa 700, no tracking.

shadows.name: off-register-blue
shadows.purpose: Second ink pass a hair off register on display type (print effect, not elevation).

shadows.name: double-rule
shadows.purpose: Builds a double rule under a 2px top border; zero blur.

surfaces.name: paper-grain
surfaces.value: body::before fixed fractalNoise SVG (240px), pointer-events none, z-index 100; opacity 0.32 multiply (day) / 0.22 screen (night)
surfaces.purpose: Poster-stock grain over everything; never intercepts input.

surfaces.name: mottle
surfaces.value: var(--mottle) fractalNoise SVG at background-size 260px over solid ink
surfaces.purpose: Paper shows through solid ink blocks.

surfaces.name: worn
surfaces.purpose: Dry spots in worn wood type.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing for presses, stamps, rises and state changes.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button and choice transform, colour and opacity transitions (hover lift -1px, active translateY(1px) scale(0.985)).

motion.name: press-in
motion.value: 340ms; scale(1.12) blur(1.5px) opacity 0.2 -> scale(0.985) at 60% -> scale(1)
motion.purpose: Each new bid pressed onto the bill.

motion.name: stamp-slam
motion.value: 420ms; rotate(var(--stamp-rot, -9deg)) scale(2.2) opacity 0 -> scale(0.94) at 55% -> scale(1)

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Reveals, resume block, next-round control, match events.

motion.name: fuse
motion.value: 100ms linear transform (scaleX from the start edge)

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Instant swap; final state always correct.

night.selector: :root[data-theme="night"], or prefers-color-scheme: dark when no data-theme is set
night.tokens: night-* keys replace their unprefixed names in place

constraints: No club logos, official crests, player photos or likenesses: clubs are kit-colour monogram roundels, nations are flags with alt names, teams are generated crests (4 shapes x 6 marks) in corner ink.
Colour is never the only signal: every corner ink has a text label.
RTL first; logical properties; directional icons flip.
WCAG AA contrast; pinch-zoom allowed; reduced motion respected.

narrative.overview:
Every auction round is a freshly printed boxing-style poster in the Hatch Show Print tradition. The open lot is the headline act, set in condensed wood type that fills the full measure. The two managers are billed against each other as the RED corner and the BLUE corner. The ground is cream poster stock with visible paper grain. Every mark on it is ink: solid blocks that show a mottle of paper through them, heavy black rules, star ornaments, and a second ink pass that lands a hair off register.

The density is that of a bill, not an app. Bands run edge to edge and are separated by 3–4px rules. Type is sized to fill its measure rather than picked from a fixed scale (see FitText). Numbers are the loudest thing on screen because the table has to be read from across a couch. There is a night-print variant: the same inks on black stock, chosen by `data-theme="night"` or by the OS dark preference.

Motion is the press. A new bid is pulled onto the poster as one impression, the previous bid stays behind as a dry ghost, and SOLD is a rubber stamp slammed at an angle. The system refuses the category default of glowing gold player cards on a dark pitch-green background.
keyCharacteristics: Cream poster stock with multiply grain (paper) or screen grain (night), fixed over everything and never intercepting input.
Two corner inks, barn red and deep blue. Each always appears with a text label, so colour is never the only signal.
Condensed wood type for display, a slab face for figures, and Changa for reading text. Arabic-first, with Arabic fallbacks in every stack.
Square printed blocks (2px radius) with an inner printed hairline.
Flat print depth: rules, outlines and ink, never floating cards.
Motion grammar is press-in, stamp-slam and rise. Under reduced motion these become an instant swap.

rules.name: The Two Corners Rule
rules.body: Red and blue mean only "red corner" and "blue corner" (plus red as primary action and SOLD). Never introduce a third team or status hue. Every red or blue mark has a text partner, such as the corner label, the name or "RED/BLUE".

rules.name: The Overprint Rule
rules.body: A tinted surface is the corner ink mixed into transparent (`color-mix(in srgb, var(--corner) 10–12%, transparent)`), never a new pastel token. This is how the bout side whose turn it is, and the current squad row, are lit.

rules.name: The Night Print Rule
rules.body: Night is the same poster pulled on black stock, not a separate theme. Every token swaps in place. Grain flips from multiply (0.32) to screen (0.22), and on-colours flip to black stock.

rules.name: The Full Measure Rule
rules.body: Headline wood type is sized to its container (`container-type: inline-size` with `cqi` clamps, or FitText between min and max px). It is not chosen from a fixed ramp. A line of wood type spans the bill.

rules.name: The Western Digits Rule
rules.body: Every number uses `.num`: tabular lining figures, `direction: ltr` and isolated bidi. Digits are always en-US, including in Arabic.

rules.name: The Ink, Not Air Rule
rules.body: Separate things with a rule, an outline or a change of ink, never a blurred drop shadow or a lifted card.

dos: Do separate regions with ink rules (4px bands, 3px blocks, 2px tables, 1px ghost) and inset outlines.
Do fill the measure with display wood type using container-query clamps or FitText.
Do pair every red or blue signal with a text label for the corner, name or turn.
Do print solid blocks with the paper mottle and an inner hairline, so ink never reads as a flat digital fill.
Do set every number with `.num` in Western digits.
Do design RTL first using logical properties, with Arabic fallbacks in every font stack.
Do honour reduced motion by making it an instant swap. A stamp or bid must be legible at its final state with no animation.
Do render clubs as kit-colour monogram roundels and teams as generated crests.
donts: Don't use club logos, official crests, player photos or likenesses.
Don't add a third accent hue or a gold or glow treatment. The palette is stock, ink, red and blue.
Don't use rounded cards, pill buttons or blurred drop shadows to create depth.
Don't make colour the only carrier of team or turn.
Don't use system display faces. The wood type is Big Shoulders Display or Lalezar, and the slab is Alfa Slab One or Rakkas.
